name: Ageospatial
long_description:
Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using geospatial AI. Some of the largest Banks and Insurance companies use our Geospatial AI Operating System.

insurers price buildings they’ve never seen. banks lend money on land they may never visit. so we take a look using geospatial data.

give us an address or a list of properties. our AI checks satellite images, street photos and public records alongside the customer’s own files. we put what we find in one operating system, with the source behind each finding.

an underwriter can see what a building is used for, what’s on its roof and whether it sits in a flood zone before deciding what premium to charge. a bank can use the same product to check whether a farmer planted the crop it financed, on the land it financed. one insurance company told us they found in seconds what would have taken them hours to look up by hand.
one_liner: Physical intelligence for every decision with Geospatial AI.
